PROPOSED

One choice at the top that fills five fields. Then only what is genuinely required — site and title. Everything else folded, with each row saying what is already in it.

A footer that never scrolls away: when the draft last saved, what is still missing, and Create.
Measured, not guessed: 4,699px at 390x844, and the data loss reproduced in a browser. Four fields vanish on a refused submit — exactly the four with no React state behind them.

Read this one first. Auto-saving as a draft is not a UI change — it decides what an unfinished job is to job lists, the dashboard, the calendar, exports and payroll. C keeps the blast radius to one new table.
